title: John Mack's abductees and the double identity

tellings.quote: John Mack's talking about all these abductees and they're talking about being in a fear state obviously the first time the onlogical shock you see a gray being in your bedroom or something. Then he took it one step deeper with you and he said but often the abductee starts to identify with the the being.

plain: John Mack, a psychiatrist who studied people who say they were taken by alien beings, found that his subjects at first felt terror, the shock of seeing a grey being, the small grey-skinned figure of abduction accounts, in their bedroom, but that often the abductee then began to identify with the being. Michels tells this himself, recalling what the parapsychologist Jeffrey Mishlove told him in an earlier conversation; if so, the experience changes the person's sense of who they are.
